metadata.title: AI market starting to resemble 'rubber band,' says Goldman strategist - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
AI market starting to resemble 'rubber band,' says Goldman strategist
The artificial intelligence market is like a rubber band that can only stretch so far, according to Goldman Sachs.
There's a growing divergence between so-called hyperscalers, like Amazon and Meta, that increase their commitments to spending on AI developments while also continuing to underperform and the AI hardware companies, responsible for manufacturing infrastructure, such as Nvidia and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, Rich Privorotsky, strategist at Goldman’s global banking and markets division, wrote in a note.
At the same time, the software is becoming cheaper to run in regions like China and Japan , where it's quickly being developed, he added.
